product.name: Unique PDF
product.fullName: Unique PDF: Offline PDF Editor – AI Summary, Merge, Compress & Sign
platforms: Google Chrome (Manifest V3, version 122+; Unique AI needs desktop Chrome 138+)
product.positioning: Free PDF tools with Unique AI — chat with any PDF and get instant summaries — without subscriptions, watermarks or file uploads.

descriptions.short: Chat with PDFs & get AI summaries. Edit, merge, split, compress, convert JPG to PDF, sign, protect & redact. Free, nothing uploaded.
descriptions.long: Unique PDF is a free PDF toolkit for Chrome with Unique AI by Unique Labs. Chat with any PDF and get answers with page references you can click, or turn a long report into its key points in seconds. Merge and split documents, reorder, rotate and delete pages, compress large files, turn images into PDFs and PDFs into images, add text, drawings, signatures, watermarks and page numbers, protect files with AES-256 passwords, remove passwords you know, edit metadata, and permanently redact sensitive information with automatic verification. Your files are never uploaded: everything happens in your browser, it works offline, and there are no accounts, quotas, subscriptions, watermarks or ads.

coreFeatures.name: Chat with PDF
coreFeatures.summary: Ask Unique AI anything about a PDF; answers stream in with clickable page citations and sources, follow-ups, suggested questions and export; a labelled passage search where AI isn't available.

coreFeatures.name: AI Summary
coreFeatures.summary: Unique AI turns long PDFs into key points, a TL;DR, a teaser or a headline; long documents are summarised in parts; a labelled key-sentence summary where AI isn't available.

coreFeatures.name: Split PDF
coreFeatures.summary: Every page, custom ranges, equal parts or at chosen pages; ZIP download.

coreFeatures.name: Organize pages
coreFeatures.summary: Reorder, rotate and delete pages from several PDFs in one workspace.

coreFeatures.name: Rotate, reorder, delete and extract pages
coreFeatures.summary: Visual thumbnail tools with multi-select and keyboard support.

coreFeatures.name: Compress PDF
coreFeatures.summary: Optimises images and removes unused data while keeping text searchable; optional maximum compression.

coreFeatures.name: Images to PDF
coreFeatures.summary: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP and AVIF with page size, orientation and margin controls.

coreFeatures.name: PDF to images
coreFeatures.summary: PNG or JPEG up to 600 DPI.

coreFeatures.name: Edit PDF
coreFeatures.summary: Add text, freehand drawings, highlights, shapes, arrows and images with undo/redo.

coreFeatures.name: Sign PDF
coreFeatures.summary: Draw a signature and place it anywhere (visual signature).

coreFeatures.name: Watermark
coreFeatures.summary: Text or image watermarks with opacity, rotation, position and tiling.

coreFeatures.name: Page numbers
coreFeatures.summary: Positions, formats, prefixes, suffixes and start number.

coreFeatures.name: Protect PDF
coreFeatures.summary: AES-256 password protection with optional permissions.

coreFeatures.name: Unlock PDF
coreFeatures.summary: Remove protection when you know the password.

coreFeatures.name: Redact PDF
coreFeatures.summary: Permanently remove text and areas, with verification.

coreFeatures.name: Edit metadata
coreFeatures.summary: View, edit or remove document properties.

privacyPositioning.statement: Your files stay on your device. Unique PDF processes everything locally in your browser and cannot send documents anywhere.
facts: No uploads, servers or cloud storage
Unique AI runs on the AI built into Chrome: document text, questions and answers are never sent to Unique Labs or any server
One permission: local storage for settings
Network access blocked by the extension's security policy

comparisonPositioning.$comment: Describe differences factually; do not name or disparage specific competitors, and do not claim to be the best.
comparisonPositioning.versusOnlineConverters: Many online PDF services upload documents to their servers for processing. Unique PDF processes files locally, so documents are never transmitted.
comparisonPositioning.versusFreemiumTools: Freemium tools often limit daily tasks, file sizes or add watermarks unless you subscribe. Unique PDF's tools have no quotas, watermarks or paid tiers.
comparisonPositioning.versusDesktopSuites: Full desktop PDF suites offer more advanced features (such as editing existing text or OCR) but require installation and often a licence. Unique PDF covers everyday tasks instantly in the browser at no cost.
honestLimitations: Does not edit text that already exists in a PDF (adds content on top).
No OCR or Office document conversion yet.
Visual signatures only; no certificate-based digital signing yet.

Unique AI needs desktop Chrome 138+ with enough disk space and memory for Chrome's built-in AI model; elsewhere a non-AI passage search and key-sentence summary are offered. Answers come only from the document's text (no OCR yet).

faq.a: Yes. All tools are free with no subscriptions, quotas or watermarks.
No. Files are processed on your device inside the browser. The extension's security policy blocks network connections.

Unique AI is the AI assistant built into Unique PDF by Unique Labs. You can chat with a PDF — answers link to the pages they come from — or summarize it. It runs inside your browser on the AI built into Chrome, so your document is never uploaded. Chrome downloads its AI model once on first use.

faq.q: Why does Unique AI say it isn't available?
faq.a: It needs desktop Chrome 138 or newer, about 22 GB of free disk space and a capable graphics card or 16 GB of RAM. On other devices, chat works as a search that shows the best-matching passages, and the Quick summary picks key sentences — both clearly labelled as not AI.
Yes. After installation every tool works without an internet connection.
No account or sign-in is needed.

faq.q: Can I edit existing text in a PDF?
faq.a: Not yet. You can add text, drawings, shapes, images and signatures on top of pages, or cover text with a white rectangle and type over it.
Yes. Redacted pages are rebuilt without the original content, and the result is checked automatically to confirm no text remains in the redacted areas.

faq.q: Can it remove a password I forgot?
faq.a: No. Unique PDF only removes protection when you provide the correct password; it never cracks or bypasses passwords.
Files up to 1 GB are accepted. The practical limit depends on your computer's memory; very large files can be slow.
Only your settings and, if enabled, a list of recent file names and sizes, kept in your browser. You can clear it any time.

faq.q: Which languages can I type in the editor?
faq.a: Added text uses the standard PDF fonts, which support Western European characters. Support for more scripts is on the roadmap.
